actions.name: Enrichment
actions.description: Effect: While there is a @Trait[nuclear]-type ally on the field that is not the user, the user may deploy the @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-summons.Item.VopgGzj9Rws23Gyz]{Enrichment Summon}. This summon being present increases the summoner's ATK and SPA by 20%. In the event the summoner no longer has any @Trait[nuclear]-type allies, the summon terminates.
